description: Account Abstracted Powers demonstrates ERC-4337 account abstraction integration with the Powers governance protocol. A PowersPaymaster sponsors gas fees for governance transactions, removing the need for users to hold ETH. The organisation has three roles — Admin, Delegate, and Public — and governs four flows: funding and withdrawing from the paymaster, minting ERC20 tokens, and managing role assignments. Delegates can propose and execute paymaster operations and token mints; Admins hold veto power over mints and can assign roles; any delegate can revoke a previously assigned role.

attributes.value: Fund Paymaster, Withdraw from Paymaster, Mint Tokens, Assign Roles
